name: Udta Teer Lena (Catching the Flying Arrow)
visual_description: Three-panel comic strip showing a stick figure watching an arrow fly overhead, catching it out of the air, and sticking it into their own backside with a smile.
usage_context: Used to describe knowingly inviting trouble, getting involved in avoidable drama, or bringing unnecessary problems upon oneself.

example.arrow_text: Family drama that has nothing to do with me

text_areas.description: Label describing the avoidable problem or drama passing by
Label describing the person intentionally involving themselves
